spec_match.rationale: Exercises the exact §3.1.3 grammar none | [ [ before | after ] || [ links | tabs ] ]: every keyword combination is applied to a live carousel via the real property, with CSS.supports per value and getComputedStyle readback, and the invalid double-mode form is asserted rejected.

interactive.rationale: A radio group applies each grammar variant to a real scroll-snap carousel with live ::scroll-marker dots; the rule, accept/reject verdict and computed value update on every change.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises every grammar variant on a switch with a supports matrix and computed readback; the page delivers exactly that.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers mode-first ordering, mode-alone values, the invalid two-mode declaration, none, and the intermediate-grammar browser generation that accepts position+mode but rejects mode-alone.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5109685301673984 plus both spec sections in see-also.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite asserts each grammar tier separately, the double-mode rejection, computed-value round-trip, and records the non-scriptable role contract as a manual/blocked assertion rather than faking it.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified headless in Chromium 141 (desktop 1280, emulated mobile 360x740 DPR3, and ?autorun=1 post-interaction): matrix renders yes/no per tier, 'after tabs' accepted with computed 'after tabs', clean console; the final mode-alone grammar itself cannot return true on this browser, so the accepted-path for v154 grammar is untested here and honestly labelled partial.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts smg-modes-grammar-probe, the explicit fallback branch, the double-mode rejection and the autorun apply; console output is intentional and error-free in headless runs.

design_system.rationale: All colours are styles.css variables, active markers invert background and color together, radios have 44px rows, and there is no static-card pattern.

accessibility.rationale: Native radios in a fieldset/legend, aria-live output for the readback, focus-visible outlines on markers, carousel has an aria-label, and the page explicitly separates parse evidence from role semantics it cannot claim.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-emulated 360x740 DPR3 run shows zero horizontal overflow and no console errors; the supports matrix scrolls in its own wrapper and controls stay 44px.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Style the active marker/link with :target-current and keep semantic state available to assistive technology.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Active dots use ::scroll-marker:target-current with an AA-contrast black/ivory inversion; semantic state is delegated to the mode keywords the page demonstrates, and the copy points at the accessibility panel for role verification.

guidanceConsulted.query: CSS-only carousel with scroll markers tabs accessibility
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Carousel indicators need visible current-state highlighting and keyboard reachability rather than pointer-only dots.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Markers are focusable pseudo-elements with :focus-visible outlines and a :target-current state; the keyboard contract itself is the subject of the sibling focus-order-journal concept.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify the accepted path on a modes-enabled Chrome 154 build
openQuestions.detail: Chromium 141 in this environment parses the intermediate grammar only, so the matrix rows for 'tabs', 'links' and 'links before' were verified as honest failures, not passes. When a Chrome/Canary 154+ binary is available, re-run the page and confirm those rows flip to yes and the computed serialisation matches the canonical order the spec defines.

summary: Grammar lab for scroll-marker-group modes: applies every keyword combination to a live marker-bearing carousel, reads back parser acceptance and computed value, and distinguishes the three grammar generations. Headless Chromium 141 evidence (desktop + emulated mobile + autorun) shows the intermediate-grammar partial state reported honestly; full v154 acceptance needs a 154 build to confirm.
